evidence_handles.E1: Задача: длинный текст нужно быстро превратить в понятное решение.
evidence_handles.E2: Шаг 1: вставить текст и попросить выделить только принятые решения, без описания проблемы.
evidence_handles.E3: Шаг 2: попросить модель переформулировать вывод в чек-лист из трёх пунктов.
evidence_handles.E4: Результат: вместо чтения длинного текста получается короткий чек-лист для проверки.

slides.visual_direction: A long folded paper scroll stands beside a compact sheet with three empty checkboxes, both shown as physical paper objects on a clean dark stage. The contrast visualises the supported outcome: a long text becoming a short checklist, creating an immediate practical promise.
slides.slide_purpose: Sharp comparison creates a useful surprise by contrasting the long reading process with the short checklist outcome described in E4.
slides.media_need: Generated portrait visual of a long paper scroll beside a short checklist sheet.
slides.visual_family_reason: The concrete paper transformation gives the practical hook a recognisable physical hero.
slides.generation_brief: Portrait editorial still life: a very long folded paper scroll on the left visually transitions toward a small clean checklist sheet with three empty checkbox marks on the right. No readable text, letters, logos or interface elements; dark ink background, controlled red accent, sharp studio light.
slides.story_anchor: A long text becomes a short checklist for checking.

slides.visual_direction: A long document-like paper strip is shown with most of its descriptive bulk folded away, leaving a few clearly separated decision slips in the foreground. The visual focuses on the action from E2: keep accepted decisions and remove the problem description.
slides.slide_purpose: This step translates the first instruction into one simple action: isolate accepted decisions before summarising them.
slides.media_need: Generated portrait visual showing a long paper text being reduced to a few decision slips.
slides.visual_family_reason: A calm explanatory layout suits the first filtering action and keeps the generated paper detail legible.
slides.generation_brief: Portrait editorial still life on a soft paper-coloured ground: a long folded document-like paper strip is being reduced to three or four plain decision slips placed in front of it. The slips have no text or logos; the composition clearly shows removal of descriptive bulk and selection of decisions.
slides.story_anchor: Keep only the accepted decisions and remove the problem description.

slides.visual_direction: Three blank checklist cards are arranged in a clear vertical progression beside a compressed paper strip, with the number three represented by the physical count of cards rather than printed text. This makes the second instruction concrete and easy to remember.
slides.slide_purpose: The second step turns the extracted decisions into the specified three-item checklist format.
slides.media_need: Generated portrait visual of three blank checklist cards formed from a compressed paper strip.
slides.visual_family_reason: The giant step numeral paired with a concrete checklist visual makes the second instruction instantly scannable.
slides.generation_brief: Portrait editorial still life on a graphite ground: a compressed folded paper strip opens into exactly three blank checklist cards arranged from upper left to lower right. No text, letters, logos or fake interface; the physical count of three is the central visual fact.
slides.story_anchor: The extracted conclusion is reformulated as a checklist of three points.

slides.visual_direction: A compact three-item checklist sheet sits in the foreground while the original long paper strip is pushed into the background and partially out of frame. The result is shown as a usable object, not merely described, so the audience can see the payoff of the two-step process.
slides.slide_purpose: The closing result shows the supported outcome: a short checklist that can be used for checking instead of reading the entire long text.
slides.media_need: Generated portrait result visual with a compact checklist in the foreground and a long paper strip receding behind it.
slides.visual_family_reason: The final physical result dominates the frame and gives the audience a clear visual payoff.
slides.generation_brief: Portrait editorial still life: a compact paper checklist with three plain checkbox marks is sharp in the foreground, while a much longer folded paper strip recedes behind it and partly leaves the frame. No readable text, letters or logos; warm paper ground with one controlled red accent.
slides.story_anchor: A long text has become a short checklist for checking.

structured_output.final_cta: Сохрани порядок: решения → три пункта → проверка.
structured_output.final_caption: Сначала убери описание проблемы и оставь только уже принятые решения. Затем попроси переформулировать их в три пункта — получится короткий формат, который проще быстро проверить.

creative_execution_plan.main_idea: Turn a long paper scroll into a compact checklist through a visible two-step physical transformation.
creative_execution_plan.focal_point: The changing paper object: from long, folded source material to three concise checklist cards.
creative_execution_plan.media_rationale: No real media is available, and the process is best communicated through concrete generated paper objects showing reduction and transformation.
creative_execution_plan.composition_direction: Use controlled asymmetry: oversized paper objects carry the visual narrative while short Russian copy occupies clear negative space beside or below them.
creative_execution_plan.branding_treatment: Use KAGE-style condensed hierarchy, dark and paper surfaces, and a restrained red accent with the canonical logo kept in a safe corner.
creative_execution_plan.visual_treatment: Editorial studio still life with recurring folded paper, blank cards and checklist marks; no text inside generated images, no overlays, and deliberate variation in scale across slides.
creative_execution_plan.avoid_recent_treatment: No recent Instagram content is available, so no specific treatment needs to be avoided.

visual_rhythm.arc: The carousel moves from a sharp long-text-versus-checklist contrast to filtering, compression into three points, and a clearly shown usable result.
visual_rhythm.repetition_note: The same paper transformation motif repeats across slides with changing scale and stage: scroll, selected decisions, three cards, finished checklist.
